description: Turn the user's daily reminders on or off: the evening 'nothing logged today' nudge and the streak reminder. Same as the app's Notifications screen. Needs the user's "Change goals & settings" switch for this connection. The user is notified of the change.

tz_offset_min.description: The user's JS getTimezoneOffset(). Only used if the app has never reported their timezone; then it's required.

name: update_reminders
